approved_scope.title: An archive-introduction listing over the output bound is split instead of read one commit at a time
approved_scope.description: An archive-introduction listing over the output bound is split instead of read one commit at a time
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-135 says the Git processes a cold archived change status spawns SHALL NOT grow with the number of commits that introduced archives; a combined diff-tree listing over the output bound fell back to one diff-tree per commit (#942)
acceptance_criteria: with an output bound below the combined listing, archive_introduction_listings splits it in halves until each part fits, returns listings equal to the unbounded ones, and spawns fewer Git processes than archive-introducing commits; a single commit over the bound is still read on its own
